prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin to establish rules for [adoption, new_screen], [finish, new_flow], [finish, new_screen], [sign_in, notification], and [sign_in, reorder] since each kind of change has only one test so far.
Evidence for [adoption, new_flow] remains mixed: one test won (+7.7% after noise correction), while the other showed no clear effect (-1.6% after noise correction).
Evidence for [adoption, redesign] remains inconclusive across three tests: one stopped early (-8.5% after noise correction), one showed no clear effect (+0.8%), and one won (+5.5%).
[finish, redesign] changes tend to be helpful, as two of three tests won (+5.6% and +4.4% after noise correction), while one showed no clear effect.
Predictions were consistently too low for all winning tests across all rounds.
Predictions were usually too high for tests that stopped early or showed no clear effect, with round 11 as the sole exception.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +2.6% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- adoption, new_screen: +4.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: +0.0% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- finish, new_flow: +10.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -6.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, redesign: +2.9% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- sign_in, notification: +1.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -8.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 74.0%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 83.7%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 28.0%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, layout] Story Scroll Path Selector Layout: Present the initial path selection screen using a story scroll layout with structured path feature previews. (why: Path selection has a wide mean completion time (514s vs 8s median), showing that some users stall while choosing their starting route.)
1: [sign_in, notification] Sign In Desktop Sync Notification Prompt: Display a notification banner on the sign-in screen confirming account sync status and pet data retention benefits. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets missing or reset after signing in again; reassuring users before auth improves confidence.)
2: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Care Basics Briefing Screen: Add a dedicated pet care briefing screen right after adoption certificate confirmation to explain essential desktop pet controls. (why: Adoption step takes a long mean time (1017s) and 3 support emails reported post-onboarding confusion on how to control or hide pets.)
3: [home, wait_info] Desktop Preload Progress Tip Carousel: Add a tip carousel and time estimate counter to the waiting screen explaining desktop pet shortcuts while companion assets load. (why: The waiting stage in home step takes median 201s (mean 2336s), causing potential drop-off or confusion about desktop pet loading status.)
4: [finish, new_flow] Interactive Companion Desktop Setup Flow: Introduce a interactive desktop placement sub-flow within home intro that guides users through hiding, showing, and positioning their pet. (why: 3 support tickets raised confusion on hiding/talking to pets and 4 cited post-onboarding desktop feature misbehavior.)
5: [sign_in, hint] Account Recovery & Sync Assurance Hint: Add a dedicated security assurance hint directly on the sign-in options explaining instant account recovery. (why: 8 users emailed about pets being missing or reset after sign-in; explicit sign-in copy alleviates account loss fears.)
6: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Companion Dock Redesign: Redesign the home_intro screen into a full-bleed showcase with quick control callouts and launch verification buttons. (why: Finish redesigns show strong history (+5.6% and +4.4% in prior tests) and address post-onboarding control confusion.)
7: [home, copy] Desktop Launch Guidance Headline Update: Update the headline and hint copy on the waiting screen to clarify desktop companion generation steps. (why: The home stage waiting screen has high mean latency (2336s); reassuring copy reduces user anxiety during generation.)
